ns2:section.sectionText: A brand's image, reputation and presence can be significantly impacted by the rapidly changing digital media ecosystem, mainstream adoptions of AI, automation, immersive technologies, and swift shifts in audience behavior. This course provides an overview of the digital media landscape as well as practical insights for brand managers and marketing communication professionals to strategically leverage different media channels for different audiences and contexts. Focus on the underlying technological affordances of existing digital media platforms and emerging media technologies. Non-Degree seeking students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of the department. To request enrollment, please contact ms-sbc@illinois.edu.
